highlights_headline: Upcoming servicing fixes improve raster-pipeline failure handling, conic regions and texture sampling.

bullets.detail: Prevents a partially constructed runtime-shader raster pipeline from executing after stage construction fails. Corrects conic-region buffer sizing and rejects edge-count overflow to prevent out-of-bounds writes.

Disables unsupported RGBA uploads to BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx on GLES. Preserves nearest-filtered texture subset boundaries under magnification and fractional mappings without dropping the integer-mapping fast path.
